subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw permanently support third-party passive-capture files, and should the initial contract be source-neutral or limited to Scrollmark canonical bundle v1?
rationale: This choice establishes durable schema, provenance, account-binding, collection-completeness, backup, and compatibility behavior for future capture sources; current repository behavior does not determine that contract.

options.title: Approve source-neutral contract
options.body: Define one permanent capture-source/run model and land Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 as the first adapter, deferring ambiguous legacy formats until their mappings are proven.

options.title: Approve Scrollmark-only MVP
options.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark bundle with a narrower schema commitment and revisit generic adapters after real usage.

options.title: Defer capture imports
options.body: Keep official X archives and Birdclaw-owned live transports as the supported sources until storage and backup contracts stabilize further.

recommendation.title: Approve source-neutral contract
recommendation.body: Define one permanent capture-source/run model and land Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 as the first adapter, deferring ambiguous legacy formats until their mappings are proven.
